notes.title: Trading Cards are now available!
notes.content:
Hey guys,
I'm pleased to inform you that trading cards for BuildMoreCubes are now available. 
Enjoy!


What is to come with the next update:
- 2 new units
- 5 new levels
- some performance optimization and bugfixing

notes.title: Fix for game crash on full screen for some people
notes.content:
First method 
- go to /system folder of the game and start directly buildmorecubes.exe file. 
That should fix the problem. 
Just for now you must start the game directly from buildmorecubes.exe and NOT by its steam icon. 

OR 

Second method 
Just find "buildmorecubes.exe" in /system folder of the game and set it to "run as administrator". 
That also should fix the problem.

notes.title: Hot fix 01
notes.content:
Hey guys,
Due to some requests I've made first of series of hot fixes

What's in it:
- Now world map should zoom-in properly 
- Unit stuck on obstacles/"magnetizing" on obstacles bug should be fixed.
- Now "Last unit invisible" bug should be fixed.
- Now re-building units while "end screen" appears is fixed.
- Overall unit control slightly improved.

Game crash fix:

First method 
- go to /system folder of the game and start directly buildmorecubes.exe file. 
That should fix the problem. 
Just for now you must start the game directly from buildmorecubes.exe and NOT by its steam icon. 

OR 

Second method 
Just find "buildmorecubes.exe" in /system folder of the game and set it to "run as administrator". 
That also should fix the problem.
